messages:
sam_pm: Quick thread — planning session notes from today's observability sync. Goal: decide EA scope for Console telemetry (cost visibility, lightweight traces, CSV export, error triage). Need prioritization for customer asks and clear launch gates.

kai_infra: Two big backend concerns: schema migration for per-customer rollups, and storage cost if we don't sample traces aggressively.

ana_obs: Suggestion: separate "billing-grade" metrics (accurate, daily rolled, exportable) from "debug-grade" traces (sampled, short retention). That satisfies procurement teams and debuggers.

enterprise_ops: From enterprise POV: CSV export + per-API-key daily spend + SLA alerting is non-negotiable. Also need documentation for how costs are derived.

tom_sre: Operational constraints: we can add a compacted cost time-series (1m -> 5m windows) and keep it for 90d. Traces: keep sampled spans 7d; keep an on-demand full-capture toggle for customer support sessions.

sam_pm: Proposed EA must-haves (compressed):
- Per-route daily and 24h cost summary page (filter by model, deployment type, route, API-key). CSV export for API-key/day.
- Sampling-first trace hooks: model.exec and kv-cache spans with trace-id propagation. Default sample 0.5%.
- Error analytics: top error routes, first-error sample, and error-rate trend.
- Regression alerts: nightly eval job against up to 3 prompt-sets per customer with threshold config.

lucy_design: UX request: add a "billing explanation" flyout next to cost numbers (tooltip) showing tokens -> pricing calc. Also lightweight drilldown for traces that links to the full request in Support view (if retained).

ana_obs: For regression alerts, backend should store failing inputs (anonymized) and provide a replay link that runs the input against a pinned model for comparison. Keep stored inputs for 30d.

enterprise_ops: Important: Private deployments need an opt-out for example collection. We'll need an explicit check box and a separate export workflow through support channels.

kai_infra: Implementation plan:
- Week 1–2: telemetry schema changes + migration window (coord with SRE)
- Week 3–5: runtime hooks + on-demand capture toggle
- Week 4–7: aggregation pipelines + CSV export endpoints
- Week 6–8: Console UI + alerting config
Parallelize where possible.

tom_sre: Acceptance/launch criteria proposal:
1) Cost dashboard shows consistent totals compared to billing invoices for 3 customers in test (diff < 2%).
2) Tracing hook emits model.exec span in 90% of sampled sessions (smoke test).
3) Regression alert pipeline detects injected regressions in test prompt set (smoke test).
4) Private-deployment opt-out tested and documented.
5) Security review signoff on export flow.

sam_pm: Tradeoffs to discuss in prioritization meeting:
- Lower sampling increases cost debugging difficulty.
- Longer retention improves support but increases storage and compliance burden.
- Immediate exports vs batched exports for large customers (throughput impact).
Which of these do we relax if we need to cut scope?

enterprise_ops: Prefer to relax trace retention (keep short) rather than remove export. Exports are contract-level.

lucy_design: Will prototype the billing flyout + error drilldown tomorrow. Keep it compact for the Console.

kai_infra: One more ask: add request-id propagation header for correlation (`x-rd-request-id`). Runtime will ensure it surfaces in spans and billing logs.

ci-bot: staging deploy scheduled: telemetry-schema-v3 -> staging at 1717129600 by CI.

sam_pm: Great. Owners: Kai (infra) for schema/export, Ana (observability) for pipeline/alerts, Lucy (design) for UI, Tom (SRE) for retention/compliance. I'll add this to prioritization board and bring final scope to Monday's roadmap review.

enterprise_ops: Thanks — we'll validate export format requirements and share a sample invoice to verify totals.

sam_pm: End of thread — will post prioritized scope after review.
